scope: Inventory copied from existing catalogue and previous mission areas; not an independent verification or complete all-calculation inventory.

assumptions: MSE from surface parameters (no downhole WOB/torque correction)
constant ROP/WOB/torque within the interval
limitations: surface-measured values include friction losses and vibration effects
no bit wear or dull-grading correction
requires a reference MSE or rock strength for absolute judgements
engines.remaining: Independent source-to-report reference and failure/boundary verification

assumptions: laminar Bingham-plastic rheology (PV/YP)
slot approximation for the annulus
clean concentric geometry; surface pressure loss is caller-declared at the specified flow rate
cuttings are spherical with the declared density and diameter
limitations: turbulent flow is detected (Reynolds) but not modelled: results are optimistic in that regime
Herschel-Bulkley / power-law fluids are not supported yet
no temperature/pressure-dependent density, no eccentricity, no surge/swab
cuttings screening assumes an isolated sphere in Newtonian fluid at plastic viscosity; no yield stress, inclination, eccentricity or beds; particle Re <= 1000
cuttings volume fraction assumes no slip and is not a bed concentration or validated hole-cleaning design
motor/BHA and tool joint pressure losses and surface losses must be explicitly declared; eccentricity is not modeled
total/standpipe unavailable without nozzle and additional downhole-loss input; standpipe also requires surface-loss input; declarations are not verified
engines.remaining: Independent source-to-report reference and failure/boundary verification

assumptions: steady fully developed laminar pipe flow
time-independent power-law rheology
limitations: single pipe only; no annulus, ECD, nozzle, fittings, surface network or total well pressure
transition screen does not establish actual flow regime; no turbulent calculation
rheology and range are caller declarations; no sample, temperature or field validation
K has index-dependent units Pa·s^n and is not automatically unit-converted
engines.remaining: Independent source-to-report reference and failure/boundary verification

assumptions: the declared barrier elements and their depth intervals are accurate
independence is expressed through the independence group
a verified element without an evidence reference is treated as unverified
limitations: does not size barriers against actual pressure loads (use the tubular/cement design engines)
no annular pressure or sustained-casing-pressure diagnostics
no risk-based anomaly trending
engines.remaining: Independent source-to-report reference and failure/boundary verification

assumptions: well attributes are comparable and consistently reported (same datum and definitions)
the analyst choose the weights, tolerances and the minimum coverage
formation names refer to the same stratigraphic nomenclature across wells
limitations: no learned similarity (geological or trajectory embedding) — factors are declared and inspectable
no automatic outlier removal beyond the explicit exclusions and coverage rule
hazard aggregation is descriptive; it does not compute probabilities
engines.remaining: Independent source-to-report reference and failure/boundary verification

assumptions: candidate objective values are trusted as produced by the engines
the caller declares direction and weight of each objective
limitations: no surrogate or gradient-based search
no interaction terms between parameters
engines.remaining: Independent source-to-report reference and failure/boundary verification

assumptions: parameters are independent
ranges are physically admissible as supplied
limitations: no surrogate modelling
no adaptive sampling
engines.remaining: Independent source-to-report reference and failure/boundary verification

assumptions: quantity available reflects the inventory at the as-of date
lead times are calendar days and do not model partial shipments
certification validity covers the whole operation window
limitations: no probabilistic lead-time modelling
no cost or vendor-priority optimisation
personnel competency matrices are out of scope for this engine
engines.remaining: Independent source-to-report reference and failure/boundary verification

assumptions: depths are measured depth in the declared datum
strings are concentric and vertical for the purpose of annulus capacity derivation
cement is shown as a top-to-shoe interval without internal displacement detail
limitations: no deviated-schematic projection (a TVD view requires the trajectory)
no centraliser, coupling or accessory detail
cement quality and channeling are not represented
engines.remaining: Independent source-to-report reference and failure/boundary verification

assumptions: soft string: bending stiffness is neglected
constant Coulomb friction coefficients over the whole string
buoyancy via density ratio
limitations: no buckling (sinusoidal/helical) or lock-up analysis
no temperature/curvature-dependent friction, no tool-joint local effects
stretch is linear-elastic only
engines.remaining: Independent source-to-report reference and failure/boundary verification

assumptions: straight line between supplied positions
common absolute coordinate frame and vertical datum declared by caller
limitations: GEOMETRIC_PROXIMITY_ONLY
no uncertainty covariance, separation factor or ISCWSA model
survey curvature between stations is not modeled
caller-provided coordinates and references are not independently verified
engines.remaining: Independent source-to-report reference and failure/boundary verification

assumptions: minimum curvature between stations
constant inclination/azimuth rate within an interval
station and vertical-section azimuth references must be explicit and compatible with the common output reference
no azimuth-reference conversion or vertical-datum compatibility is inferred
an explicit signed correction is required for conversion into a named grid frame
limitations: does not model bending moments, toolface history or BHA sag
tight-radius and high-dogleg rotary-steerable behaviour is only as accurate as station spacing
does not derive magnetic declination/grid convergence; caller-supplied corrections are not independently verified
does not perform anti-collision or error-model (ISCWSA) uncertainty analysis
engines.remaining: Independent source-to-report reference and failure/boundary verification

assumptions: nominal wall thickness (manufacturer tolerances other than the API 0.875 burst factor are not applied)
yield strength is the specified minimum for the grade
pressure loads are static, no thermal or bending stresses beyond the axial term
limitations: pipe body only: no connection, coupling or thread rating
no buckling or bending stress from doglegs
bending, thermal and dynamic loads must be added by a dedicated design workflow
engines.remaining: Independent source-to-report reference and failure/boundary verification

assumptions: both surveys are processed with minimum curvature using their own tie-in
actual position between survey stations is interpolated linearly in MD
the actual survey is anchored to the planned first station by default
limitations: no positional uncertainty (ISCWSA) model
no automatic detection of a wrong tie-in or datum shift beyond the anchor statement
predicted rather than surveyed positions must be passed as `actual` deliberately
engines.remaining: Independent source-to-report reference and failure/boundary verification

assumptions: single influx, steady-state shut-in pressures
kill rate pressure (KRP) measured at the slow kill rate and dominated by drillstring/bit friction
no annular friction while shut in and negligible annular friction during kill circulation
volumetric_kick_tolerance_si (when computed) uses a preliminary single-bubble unmigrated balance at the casing shoe
limitations: does not model multi-phase gas expansion, real-gas Z-factor compressibility, or oil-based mud gas solubility
mud_weight_margin_si (and deprecated alias kick_tolerance_mud_weight_si) is a static shoe mud-weight margin (kg/m3), not a multi-phase volumetric kick tolerance
not a substitute for a certified well control procedure or IWCF/IADC WellSharp training
engines.remaining: Independent source-to-report reference and failure/boundary verification

assumptions: nominal diameters, no tool-joint allowance
largest inner tubular OD per interval
limitations: no eccentricity or washout
does not resolve multiple nested strings beyond the largest OD
unoccupied intervals require an explicit user declaration, not independent verification
engines.remaining: Independent source-to-report reference and failure/boundary verification
